image_description: A large bison stands in profile on a dirt path, facing right. The animal has a massive shoulder hump covered in dark, shaggy fur, while the hindquarters appear smoother with patches of shedding or mud. Small birds are perched on the bison's back. In the background, there is a green pasture enclosed by a wire fence, with another bison visible in the distance.

checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The head is clearly visible, showing the characteristic broad shape and short, curved horn typical of a bison.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Beard of long hair on chin and throat.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: A distinct beard of long, dark hair hangs from the chin and throat area.
The eye is visible and appears dark, consistent with the species.
Ears are not prominently sticking out; they are small and blend into the thick fur of the head.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Massive body with exceptionally tall, heavily built proportions at the withers.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The animal exhibits the classic bison silhouette with a significantly higher front end due to the shoulder hump.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Shaggy dark brown fur covering forequarters forming prominent shoulder hump.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The forequarters are covered in thick, shaggy dark fur that creates the defining hump.
The rear section of the body has shorter, smoother hair compared to the front, revealing skin texture/mud patches.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Short horns compared to body size.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The horns are visibly short relative to the massive size of the head and body.
The lower legs and feet are obscured by tall grass in the foreground and the angle of the shot, making hooves impossible to verify.
The tail is completely occluded by the angle of the animal's body and the perspective; it is not visible in the frame.
